descriptor.scene: Late at night, the study nearly dark. MARCUS IS STANDING AND HAS JUST CLOSED THE LID of the laptop on his desk, one hand still resting on it, turning to leave the room. THE CLOSED LAPTOP IS DARK AND ORDINARY AND DOES NOT GLOW AT ALL. But THROUGH THE OPEN DOORWAY AT THE FAR LEFT, out in the dark hallway, a SECOND MACHINE stands open on a side table and IT IS STILL GLOWING DEEP INDIGO, wholly translucent and luminous throughout, with STORYWELL small inside it still bent over its work, head down, entirely unbothered that he has gone. The contrast between the dark closed machine under his hand and the distant one still working is the whole picture. He is looking back at it over his shoulder. NO ORANGE ANYWHERE.
